responsibility: This definition file is the master builtin table for GCC’s Pointer Bounds Checker (CHKP) support. It declaratively lists the compiler-only CHKP instrumentation builtins, user-visible __bnd_* bounds-manipulation and checking builtins, and CHKP-specific libc-like helper variants, giving each builtin its enum name, external symbol spelling, builtin type signature, and attribute set through DEF_BUILTIN_STUB and DEF_CHKP_BUILTIN entries. Its role is to feed builtin registration, typing, and target-hook/lowering code for the CHKP subsystem, especially the Pointer Bounds Checker pass and target-provided builtin_chkp_function handling, rather than implementing the transformations itself.
